I am leading a project focused on expanding who we consider when designing accessible technologies, both engaging nondisabled people in collective access approaches and investigating how to better support underserved disability groups, such as people with chronic health disabilities. If you are looking to collaborate in this space, please reach out! Previously I was a National Library of Medicine Postdoctoral Fellow in Biomedical Informatics and Medical Education at the University of Washington School of Medicine.
